description.en: concrete pump integral piston φ225 is restated under Cummins. A φ225 integral piston is one outer-diameter row on the Xingtai one-piece piston page. The unit is a piece. Material is a missing field. No published pump page names φ225 as its piston.

h1.en: The printed concrete pump integral piston φ225 line, ordered as Cummins orders its page
h1.zh: 已印的concrete pump integral piston φ225，按《Cummins》的页面次序来写

directAnswer.en: Cummins is an encyclopedia page. concrete pump integral piston φ225 remains a Xingtai catalogue line. The two meet only in the order of the sections. A φ225 integral piston is one outer-diameter row on the Xingtai one-piece piston page. The unit is a piece. Material is a missing field. No published pump page names φ225 as its piston.
directAnswer.zh: 《Cummins》是百科页。concrete pump integral piston φ225仍是邢台目录中的一行。两者只在章节次序上相遇。 φ225 整体活塞是邢台整体活塞页上的一条外径。单位是个。材料是缺字段。没有已公布泵页把 φ225 写成自己的活塞。

body.en: The source page divides this subject at “History”. The words under that heading, in this note, stay inside the Xingtai wording already printed. The integral piston page lists φ150, φ160, φ180, φ195, φ200, φ205, φ210, φ220, φ225, φ230 and φ250, sold per piece, as replacement parts rather than OEM parts of other brands. This note is only φ225. Rubber, rubber-cloth and polyurethane are printed on the split-piston page, not as a material for this integral row. This wear-part page does not name a pump model for the size. The same numeral on a pump page is not an assignment. Confirm the size on the machine. φ225 is not on the split-piston list. Do not switch the order to a split set. No neighbouring page’s figure is copied onto this row.
body.zh: 来源页在“历史”处分开叙述。这一节沿用该标题，底下只重复邢台已经印出的说法。 整体活塞页列出 φ150, φ160, φ180, φ195, φ200, φ205, φ210, φ220, φ225, φ230 and φ250，按个供货，并写明是替换件，不是其他品牌原厂件。本文只写 φ225。橡胶、橡胶夹布和聚氨酯印在分体活塞页上，不是这一整体活塞行的材料。 这张易损件页没有把该尺寸写到某一台已公布泵上。泵页上出现同一个数字，也不等于已经指定机型。请在机器上核对尺寸。φ225 不在分体活塞清单里。不要改成订分体套件。 不把旁边那一页的数字抄到这一行。

body.en: “Business units” is a heading on the crawled page, used here only as the section name. It does not create a measurement. Hebei Pinjin Machinery (河北品锦机械) in Xingtai does not print a list price for this spare, and the page does not sell it as a small parcel. Write through the contact page by email or WhatsApp. Write integral piston, φ225, and the quantity in pieces. Do not add a material the page does not print. The heading stops there.
body.zh: “来源章节：Business units”是抓到的那一页自己的章节名，这里只拿来当标题，不另造一个测量值。 邢台河北品锦机械没有为这件配件公布标价，也不按小包裹销售。请走联系页，用邮件或 WhatsApp 写给工厂。 写明整体活塞、φ225 和个数。不要补上页面没有印的材料。 标题到此为止。

body.en: “Subsidiaries” is a heading on the crawled page, used here only as the section name. It does not create a measurement. A φ225 integral piston is one outer-diameter row on the Xingtai one-piece piston page. The unit is a piece. Material is a missing field. No published pump page names φ225 as its piston. The heading stops there.
body.zh: “来源章节：Subsidiaries”是抓到的那一页自己的章节名，这里只拿来当标题，不另造一个测量值。 φ225 整体活塞是邢台整体活塞页上的一条外径。单位是个。材料是缺字段。没有已公布泵页把 φ225 写成自己的活塞。 标题到此为止。

body.en: The source page divides this subject at “Joint Ventures”. The words under that heading, in this note, stay inside the Xingtai wording already printed. This wear-part page does not name a pump model for the size. The same numeral on a pump page is not an assignment. Confirm the size on the machine. A service life, a replacement-hour figure and a wear-rate table are not printed. Leave that field blank. Unprinted cells stay unprinted.
body.zh: 来源页在“来源章节：Joint Ventures”处分开叙述。这一节沿用该标题，底下只重复邢台已经印出的说法。 这张易损件页没有把该尺寸写到某一台已公布泵上。泵页上出现同一个数字，也不等于已经指定机型。请在机器上核对尺寸。 使用寿命、更换小时和磨损速率都没有印出。这一栏留空。 没有印出的格子保持不印。

body.en: A reader who opens the source page will find “Applications”. This note keeps the heading and puts the printed fragment beneath it. Hebei Pinjin Machinery (河北品锦机械) in Xingtai does not print a list price for this spare, and the page does not sell it as a small parcel. Write through the contact page by email or WhatsApp. The heading stops there.
body.zh: 打开来源页会看到“用途”。这篇笔记保留该标题，并把已印片段放在标题下面。 邢台河北品锦机械没有为这件配件公布标价，也不按小包裹销售。请走联系页，用邮件或 WhatsApp 写给工厂。 标题到此为止。

body.en: A reader who opens the source page will find “Leadership”. This note keeps the heading and puts the printed fragment beneath it. The page calls them Xingtai replacement wear parts, not OEM parts of other pump brands. Unprinted cells stay unprinted.
body.zh: 打开来源页会看到“来源章节：Leadership”。这篇笔记保留该标题，并把已印片段放在标题下面。 页面写的是邢台替换易损件，不是其他泵品牌的原厂件。 没有印出的格子保持不印。

heading.zh: 来源章节：Clean Air Act violations

body.en: Nothing about the phrase “Clean Air Act violations” is a second data sheet. The data-sheet fragment, if one was printed, is quoted next. Email or WhatsApp Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai, and name the 整体活塞 page plus this size and the quantity. The heading stops there. Image from the source page: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cummins
body.zh: “来源章节：Clean Air Act violations”这几个字不是第二张数据表。若目录印过数据，下面引用的才是那一句。 用邮件或 WhatsApp 写给邢台河北品锦机械，写明整体活塞这一页、这一尺寸和数量。 标题到此为止。 图来自来源页：https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cummins

question.en: Why is Cummins not a source of extra ratings for concrete pump integral piston φ225?
question.zh: 为什么《Cummins》不能给concrete pump integral piston φ225增加额定值？

answer.en: This wear-part page does not name a pump model for the size. The same numeral on a pump page is not an assignment. Confirm the size on the machine. The heading and the source photograph do not add a further figure.
answer.zh: 这张易损件页没有把该尺寸写到某一台已公布泵上。泵页上出现同一个数字，也不等于已经指定机型。请在机器上核对尺寸。 章节标题和来源图片都不另加数字。

question.en: Can the outline heading “Subsidiaries” rename concrete pump integral piston φ225?
question.zh: 大纲标题“来源章节：Subsidiaries”可以改掉concrete pump integral piston φ225的名称吗？

answer.en: A service life, a replacement-hour figure and a wear-rate table are not printed. Leave that field blank. The heading and the source photograph do not add a further figure.
answer.zh: 使用寿命、更换小时和磨损速率都没有印出。这一栏留空。 章节标题和来源图片都不另加数字。

answer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery (河北品锦机械) in Xingtai does not print a list price for this spare, and the page does not sell it as a small parcel. Write through the contact page by email or WhatsApp. The heading and the source photograph do not add a further figure.
answer.zh: 邢台河北品锦机械没有为这件配件公布标价，也不按小包裹销售。请走联系页，用邮件或 WhatsApp 写给工厂。 章节标题和来源图片都不另加数字。
